statements.impact_statement: OpenSSH password authentication bypass, exploitable through sshd's password check on musl. The kustomize-controller v1.10.1 image (the digest above, the one flux-image-digests.lock pins) carries only the OpenSSH client packages (openssh-client-common, openssh-client-default, openssh-keygen 10.3_p1-r1): no openssh-server, no sshd binary, no sshd_config, no host key, no PAM, no account with a password hash. The entrypoint is tini then kustomize-controller, the pod listens on 8080 (metrics) and 9440 (health) only, and no Flux source in this repository uses an ssh:// URL (git_repo_url defaults to https://, as in every example).

statements.status_notes: Expires: 2027-01-09.
